name: Post-reading
description: External Post-reading reference package for the milXdy reviewed custom-build App SDK.

notes: Uses the public lifecycle, surface delivery, scheduler, cancellation, diagnostics, rescan, and routed-message context.

settings.label: Post-reading
settings.description: Add read-aloud controls to supported X posts.

notes: The milXdy runtime owns loading, cancellation, surface delivery, disable, and disposal.
The reference package retains its own floating player until shared overlay primitives become a public SDK capability.

hub.shortDescription: External SDK reference app for reading X posts aloud.
permissionNotes: Uses the host extension's storage permission and reviewed Post-reading background fetch routes.
OCR uses the host extension's packaged OCR frame and worker assets in this first reference package.
dataNotes: Reads selected public post text, quote text, link metadata, and optional image text.
Custom TTS sends selected text to the endpoint explicitly configured by the user.
localStorageNotes: Stores reader settings in sync storage and voice-boundary results in local storage.
